decision_rule_fixed_here: Read against the in-chain A/A (the module's OFF arm on lock v2.1) flown in the same campaign. PRIMARY: intent accuracy (scenario_action exact), paired per utterance, 10,000 bootstrap draws. GUARD: official pooled SLU-F1 (slurp-slu-official) non-inferior at this roster's own null (h_SLU 1.2525). REPLICATED: the intent CI95 lower bound above zero, the point at or above the 2.6 pp cross-flight bar at n = 1,000, AND the guard holds. NEUTRAL: both guards non-inferior at the own null (h_intent 1.152 / h_SLU 1.2525) without a replicated gain. HARMFUL: a measured loss on either guard (decision 25). Every verdict carries the per-stratum tables in both weightings. The A/A vs the sealed A2 A/A is reported beside, CONTEXT ONLY (the lock-v2.1 pin plus the recall-k no-op).
development_numbers_only: Every number this cell produces is a DEV-2000-ADDED development number (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim.
does_this_cell_need_to_fly: This cell does NOT need to fly for the module's end-to-end proof: the byte proof (m6) shows its composed policy blocks equal cell A2's flown arm bytes except the one lock-v2.1 Reviewer pin, and its A/A equals the lock-v2.1 bytes. What a flight would add is (a) the first measured lock-v2.1 A/A on DEV-2000-ADDED and (b) a same-roster re-flight of the admitted COMP-1b bytes under the module on lock v2.1. Whether that is worth about 3.4 GPU-h is the coordinator's decision.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. Budgets are run-cumulative across attempts.

composed_config_diffs.note: Each entry flattens two composed configs (core.config.compose). The module cell vs cell A2 = the lock-v2.1 Reviewer pin alone (the A/A also the recall k) plus the module declaration, bookkeeping and the experiment fragment; the module arm vs its A/A = the two components' leaves alone. anything_else is empty or this writer refuses.

module_byte_proof.note: m0: the all-off block on lock v2.1 composes to cell G5's flown hashes (the v2.1 bytes), and with no lock key to the v2.0 lock's. m6: each module cell's own block compiles to its own composed hash; compiled onto A2's own fragments it differs from A2's policy blocks at exactly phase_material.reviewer.instruction_template (the A/A also at the recall k, 60 -> 8).

prohibitions: No flight before the coordinator decides it is needed, root countersigns the rows, mints the decision receipt and the three cells are flipped in one converged cycle.
No re-flying of any sealed cell; no test, DEV-1000 or Fold B contact.
No component beyond the declared block; no k, tau, fuse_coverage, w_prior, store, release, snapshot, roster or geometry change outside the compiler.
No paper-scale profile. --allow-output-change is never passed.
